name: Cédric Wermuth
bio: Cédric Wermuth (born 19 February 1986 in Jegenstorf) is a Swiss politician who has been a member of the National Council (Nationalrat) for the canton of Aargau since 2011. Since October 2020 he has served as co-president of the Social Democratic Party of Switzerland (SP/PS) together with Mattea Meyer. He was raised in several Aargau communities, graduated from high school in Wohlen, and studied political science, history, economics and philosophy at the University of Zurich. A member of the Young Socialists (JUSO) from his teens, he was JUSO's central secretary from 2005 and its president from 2008 to 2011, before being elected to the National Council. He previously served as vice-president of the SP and vice-president of the SP parliamentary group. He sits on the Finance Committee (FK-N) and the Economic Affairs and Taxation Committee (WAK-N). He holds Swiss and Italian dual citizenship and lives in Zofingen with his wife and two children. He is positioned on the left of the SP, with a focus on redistribution, climate policy, public services and feminism.
